collision_check: Searched 183 openkit-*/fbx for hat|felt|brim|milliner|block|band|crown|kettle|needle-board|liner. Hits: prop-punch-block-bt1, prop-butcher-block, prop-wax-block-stack, prop-ashlar-block, prop-nail-anvil-block, prop-brow-band-blank (helm-maker armor padding), tile-roof-thatch*. None of the 4 ids taken; no prior openkit-hat* pack.
judgment_calls: Felt blank v1 had a flat skirt + crown that read as a finished brimmed hat; v2 is a brimless raw felt cone (hood) as delivered to a milliner before steaming/blocking
Hat block is a lathed rounded crown form with a two-piece wedge seam and top dowel; it is unlike the flat/rectangular punch, butcher, ashlar, wax and nail-anvil blocks
Brim wire is a bare two-turn iron stiffener coil with tape-bound ends, not a brim; 10-seg rings keep it at 184 tris (16-seg was 280)
Hatband is an undyed ribbon roll with uncut chalk-marked tail; distinct from helm-maker brow-band-blank (padded armor liner) and belt straps
Eye-check v1: block seam fin protruded above the curved crown; shortened to flush lower seam in v2. v2 shows no floating parts (all pieces sit at z=0 or overlap parent)
